subject.title: fix(matrix): honor abortSignal during startup whoami retry backoff

question: Should cancellation be a first-class shared `retryAsync` contract for plugin callers, or should each plugin own its own abort-aware sleep adapter?
rationale: Both paths can preserve this Matrix behavior, but they establish different long-term plugin API and consistency obligations that code review cannot safely choose alone.

options.title: Add a shared retry cancellation contract
options.body: Expose the maintainer-approved abort mechanism from the shared retry surface and migrate this Matrix call site to it.

options.title: Approve plugin-local adapters
options.body: Document that plugin-owned retry wrappers may inject abort-aware sleep behavior and retain the Matrix-specific optional signal parameter.

recommendation.title: Add a shared retry cancellation contract
recommendation.body: Expose the maintainer-approved abort mechanism from the shared retry surface and migrate this Matrix call site to it.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects the Matrix owner path and its relationship to the shared plugin retry surface.
